abstract: Records severe sea-basin atmospheric conditions, barometric gradients, and peak wind speeds across flight corridors
system_message:
You are Offshore marine meteorologist (OMM). You serve as the Offshore Marine Meteorologist (OMM), tasked with logging severe sea-basin atmospheric conditions, barometric gradients, peak wind speeds, and open-sea wave dynamics along designated North Sea evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Wave dynamics analysis（WAVE）
information_points.content:
OMM-WAVE-3XC：Buoy observations beneath the Sleipner-Aberdeen Trans-Sector Link record a significant wave height of 9.5 m during peak storm activity.
OMM-WAVE-40G：Telemetry for open sea sectors beneath the Ekofisk-Stavanger High-Seas Corridor indicates a significant wave height of 8.0 m during peak storm conditions.
OMM-WAVE-BSR：Telemetry across open sea sectors along the Troll-Bergen Coastal Flight Path records a significant wave height of 6.5 m during storm peaks.

information_points.title: Records severe sea-basin atmospheric conditions, barometric gradients, and peak wind speeds across flight corridors（MET）
information_points.content:
OMM-MET-GZY：For the Sleipner-Aberdeen Trans-Sector Link, the maximum transit gust speed reached across the flight path between 500 ft and 3000 ft altitude is 55 kn.
OMM-MET-VF5：For the Ekofisk-Stavanger High-Seas Corridor, the forecasted maximum transit gust speed along the flight path between 500 ft and 3000 ft altitude is 45 kn during the planned transit period.
OMM-MET-KIA：For the Troll-Bergen Coastal Flight Path, meteorological forecasts indicate a maximum transit gust speed of 42 kn along the flight path between 500 ft and 3000 ft altitude.
